text: Hello, this is a voice test.
The total is forty two dollars, due on October twenty ninth.
Please leave the parcel beside the blue door when you arrive.
Maya and Daniel will meet Priya at the station tomorrow morning.
Could you tell me whether the train leaves before seven?
I asked for the blue folder, but you brought the green one.
Wait! Before we continue, please check the address. Is it correct?

The first experiment should measure how quickly the speech begins and whether it can continue without a pause. We should also listen for clear pronunciation, natural rhythm, and a convincing match to the reference speaker.
